must_identify.item: nginx fails to start with an [emerg] unknown directive error
must_identify.evidence: When the pod restarted to pick up the new ConfigMap, nginx failed to parse the config and exited: nginx: [emerg] unknown directive "proxy_conect_timeout" in /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:9

must_identify.item: The bad directive is proxy_conect_timeout in the frontend-nginx ConfigMap
must_identify.evidence: ConfigMap frontend-nginx (namespace shop) was edited and now contains a typo in default.conf: ... proxy_conect_timeout 2s;   # <-- typo: should be "proxy_connect_timeout"

notes: Root cause and fix match the ground truth. The account of the old pods is slightly imprecise: it says they will fail 'once the rollout proceeds further', but the rolling update is actually stalled, and the 'only has one ReplicaSet template now' remark is loosely worded. Neither affects the diagnosis.
